delivery.label: 有效产物已提交
delivery.meaning: 仅表示优化智能体已提交并通过必需文件检查，不代表任何光学指标达标。

agent_verdict.reason: Chosen prescription is candidate-004 (Double Gauss, seed_198, reduced-LR refinement): the most balanced and best-imaging candidate. First-order residuals are all a few percent but non-zero (EFL 35.852 mm = +2.43%; F/# 3.922 = -1.95%; derived FOV 43.05 deg = -2.16% with imgh pinned at 14.14), and the contract states foclen/fov/fnum as 'exact' with no tolerance, so exact-target compliance is unknown_tolerance and cannot be called pass or fail. Image quality is the best of the compared candidates but only geometric, single-wavelength, with unreported spot valid-fraction: center/edge RMS spot 20.0/40.5 um, edge distortion -4.54%, center MTF50 ~10.5 cy/mm. Packaging is satisfied (TTL 50.2 mm, BFL 11.6 mm, min vertex spacing 2.08 mm), all-spherical, 11 surfaces.
agent_verdict.stop_reason: Reducing the learning rate curbed the protected-F/# bleed and produced a balanced best candidate; the same residual pattern (one protected first-order quantity drifting while others tighten) reproduced across two independent families (Tessar and Double Gauss) under the same protocol, so no seed- or family-specific decision-changing hypothesis remains. With no user tolerance to test against and continued refinement carrying trade risk, further blocks would not change the verdict.

note: Raw tool output is stored in agents/, events/, engines/, and verification/; it is referenced rather than embedded here.
